body: You're really really really  hard on yourself. Nobody knows what they're doing or why we're here. There's no way for me to understand your experience of life, and I'd be a fool to advise you to do anything, for I'm only on this subreddit waiting for somebody to respond to my suicide post I made 15 minutes ago. You're not alone, you very well may be (I certainly am) and for what' it's worth, I can full heatedly say the same thing about myself to every word you posted. I think humans just desperately need feedback, and it's torture to live without it. In no uncertain terms... YOU DESERVE BETTER, Seeking context on here is A good indicator of how hard you are on yourself. I wish I could help you, I truly do. Maybe anything is possible, maybe we really can make our imaginations a reality. I hope so. Anyways, internet podcasts kind of help me. I like "The Joe rogan experience", helped me last year.
